$comment: The spec schema sets every Janus SDK's generated bindings are built from (plan task 6.1; SDK specification spec §2 layer 1). An SDK speaks the engine protocol, builds interaction specifications out of shapes, reads variant selections and receives contracts — so it gets exactly those four designs' schemas. Component interfaces, hooks, plans and subsumption are the engine's and the CLI's business, not an SDK's; add a set here only when an SDK primitive's 'produces' names a document it governs. Regenerate with `cargo run -p pact_janus_bindings -- generate`.
